note: validateMatB1() folds detectAdditionalFlags() into its own return, so no separate flagsHint is needed. complete is true only when zero fired rules carry category 'completeness' - a fired timing/consistency/declaration rule can coexist with complete===true. The 'issue date in the future' flag reads the wall clock via new Date(), so the clock key freezes 'today' at 2026-09-03 for deterministic grading.

personas.name: Complete Part A, doctor-issued
personas.description: Pre-confinement certificate issued by a doctor 17 weeks before the expected date of confinement (within the 20-week DWP window), with every field filled, the stamp confirmed applied, and completion in ink confirmed. No rule fires (complete), no flags.

personas.name: Partial Part A with an inconsistent examination date
personas.description: Pre-confinement certificate where the examination date (15 August) falls AFTER the recorded expected date of confinement (1 August) - a consistency problem suggesting Part B should have been used instead - and the doctor's practice address is left blank. Two rules fire (the examination-after-EWC consistency check, and the missing practice-address completeness check), so complete is false. One medium flag fires for the examination-after-EWC inconsistency.

firedRules.description: Part A: examination date should not be after the EWC.
firedRules.message: Part A: examination date is after the expected date of confinement. Use Part B (post-confinement) once the baby has been born.

firedRules.description: Doctor: practice address must be provided.

additionalFlags.message: Part A examination date is after the expected date of confinement. If the baby has been born, switch to Part B (post-confinement).

personas.name: Critical, midwife-issued with lapsed registration and no certificate number
personas.description: Patient name is missing; the examination is 29 weeks before the expected date of confinement (9 weeks past the DWP's 20-week limit); leftover Part B data (an actual date of birth) coexists with the active Part A selection; the certificate is issued by a midwife whose NMC registration expired before the issue date; no certificate number is recorded; the certificate is a duplicate not marked as such; completion-in-ink is not confirmed; and the issue date is in the future relative to the frozen clock. Six rules fire (one urgent - missing certificate number - plus three high and two medium), so complete is false. Six flags fire: one urgent (missing certificate number), two high (the 20-week window breach; the lapsed NMC registration), two medium (the unmarked duplicate; both parts populated), one low (a future issue date).

firedRules.description: Unique certificate number must be recorded.
firedRules.message: Unique certificate number is missing. Every MAT B1 must use an officially supplied form bearing a unique certificate number.

firedRules.description: Patient name must be provided on the front page.
firedRules.message: Patient's name is missing on the front page (above Part A).

firedRules.description: Part A: certificate must not be issued more than 20 weeks before the EWC.
firedRules.message: Part A: examination date is more than 20 weeks before the expected date of confinement. DWP guidance prohibits issuing a MAT B1 this early.

firedRules.description: Midwife: NMC registration must not have expired on the issue date.
firedRules.message: Midwife: NMC registration expired before the issue date. A MAT B1 cannot be signed by a midwife with lapsed NMC registration.

firedRules.description: Certificate must be confirmed completed in ink.
firedRules.message: Confirmation that the certificate has been completed in ink is missing. DWP guidance requires ink (not pencil).

firedRules.description: Duplicate marker must be applied when the certificate is a duplicate.
firedRules.message: Duplicate certificate is not marked "DUPLICATE". Replacements for lost or incomplete originals must carry the DUPLICATE marker.

additionalFlags.message: Unique certificate number is missing - the DWP cannot accept a MAT B1 without an official pre-printed certificate number.
Certificate is being issued 29 weeks before the expected date of confinement. DWP guidance prohibits issuing a MAT B1 more than 20 weeks before the EWC.
Midwife's NMC registration has expired before the certificate issue date. A midwife cannot issue a MAT B1 with lapsed NMC registration.
Replacement (duplicate) certificate is not marked "DUPLICATE". DWP guidance requires the marker on all replacement certificates.
Both Part A and Part B contain data. The MAT B1 form is mutually exclusive - select only one certificate type.
Issue date is in the future. The MAT B1 should be dated the day it is signed.
